title: Don't WAVE When The Lights Go Off 💡
description:
At the storage block, the motion lights go off if nobody moves for a minute, so everybody waves. When it goes dark, you wave, and click, they come back. My big sister Jo waves a broom and calls it cardio.

Tonight Jo is moving out of unit seven, and the lights keep going off while I'm still carrying boxes. Every time they click back on, the tall grey somebody by the only way out is one door closer.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment WAVE if you've ever waved your arms at a motion light.
